Dear Magly,

Thank you for reaching out about your interview reschedule.

Please contact Salas Staffing directly to notify them about your availability change. They will be able to reschedule your interview for Monday. If you need your interview link or have any other questions, please reach out to us via WhatsApp at (+84) 989 877 953.

Let us know if you have any questions,
